Good morning, Felipe. I am Laura, the account manager for South America. Thank you for the time.
Good morning, Laura. Nice to meet you. I work in retail, and I oversee four areas here.
Four areas. Which ones, if I may ask?
Supply, facilities, maintenance and loss prevention. So I see the product before the store and the building around it.
That is a wide job. Who do you report to?
I report to the CFO. Four managers report to me, and each one runs one area.
Perfect. My company is a supplier of shelving and lighting. We work with eleven retail groups in Brazil.
Good. And how long does a delivery take? Our supply chain does not wait.
Thirty days, normally. I do not decide the price, but I do decide the date. Shall I send you the calendar today?
Please do. And send it to me, not to my team. I sign this one myself.

I studied law, but I do not practice law. I work on the operations side.

Hi Felipe, this is Laura from Northfield Supply. I am the account manager for South America, and I look after retail clients like yours. I report to our commercial director, and two people report to me. I handle contracts, delivery dates and any problem in the supply chain. I do not handle prices, so if you need a quotation, my colleague sends that. Give me a call when you have ten minutes. Thanks.

Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the retail operations forum. Before the first session, a short note about how the day works. Registration opens at eight and closes at nine thirty. Each speaker talks for twenty minutes and answers questions for ten. We do not record the sessions, so take your own notes. Lunch starts at half past twelve in the main hall, and the networking round begins right after it. Please wear your badge all day. Thank you.
